newsitem.title: USA: Sun work on Penn reformer still set for Dec.
newsitem.headline: Sun work on Penn reformer still set for Dec.

text.p: Sun Co Inc will begin a previously announced maintenance on a 28,000 barrel per day (bpd) reformer unit at its Philadelphia refinery beginning on December 1, a spokesman said.
The reformer will be out of service for 21 days, the spokesman said. The unit is part of the Girard Point portion of Sun's Philadelphia refinery.
Sun's Philadelphia refinery complex has total crude distillation capacity of 307,000 bpd, with Girard Point making up 177,000 bpd of that and Point Breeze making up the remaining 130,000 bpd.
Reformer units are used to make premium grade high-octane gasolines out of regular octane fuels.
